card.name: Cumulative totals and recoverable amounts
card.fires_on: Words naming an accumulated or recoverable quantity, such as 'barrels' after a big number of oil, 'dose' after 'cumulative', and 'able' in 'extractable' or 'recoverable'.

modes.label: Oil volume units
modes.description: The word barrels after a large figure for oil or bitumen reserves.

modes.description: The word dose right after 'cumulative' in total-dose statements.

modes.label: Recoverable endings
modes.description: The ending 'able' in words about what can be extracted or recovered.

card.writes: It leans toward words about accumulating or recovering, and away from words like immediate or active.
card.plain: It marks spots where text talks about a total built up or an amount that can be recovered.
